Package com.im.njams.sdk.communication

Class NjamsSender

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.NjamsSender
  • public class NjamsSender
extends Object
    This class enforces the maxQueueLength setting. It uses the maxQueueLengthHandler to enforce the discardPolicy, if the maxQueueLength is exceeded all message sending is funneled through this class, which creates and uses a pool of senders to multi-thread message sending

    A worker thread keeps its message across sender failures: it borrows a connected sender from the SenderPool, and if the send fails it reports the sender as broken and acquires a fresh one for the very same message. The message is deliberately never re-queued — see dispatch(CommonMessage, String). The group's startup connect and its single reconnect loop are owned by the pool, not by this class.

    Version:
    4.0.6
    Author:
    hsiegeln

      • NjamsSender

        public NjamsSender​(ClientSettings settings)
        This constructor initializes a NjamsSender. It saves the settings and gets the name for the executor threads from the settings with the key: njams.sdk.communication (or its alternative njams.sdk.communication.type). The configured communication type is validated here, so a missing or unknown transport is not left to surface later from a background connect.
        Parameters:
        settings - the setting where some settings will be taken from.
        Throws:
        IllegalStateException - if no communication type is configured, or no sender implementation is registered for the configured one.

    • Method Detail

      • takeSharedSender

        public static NjamsSender takeSharedSender​(ClientSettings settings)
        Returns the one shared sender instance. On first access, the instance is lazily created. All later access will get the same instance until the instance has closed. Then a new instance is created if required. Calling this method tracks usage of the sender instance. I.e., after taking a sender, it must be close()d to return the instance and allow the implementation to keep track of usage. Calling close() does not really close the actual sender as long as it is still being used. Only when it is no longer used (close has been called as often as it has been taken), the real sender instance will be closed finally.
        Parameters:
        settings - Only used if a new instance needs to be created.
        Returns:
        The shared sender instance as explained above.

      • beginConnect

        public void beginConnect()
        Pre-warms the group's connection in the background so a slow connect overlaps application setup. Idempotent and thread-safe; delegates to the group's single connector.

      • startWithTimeout

        public boolean startWithTimeout​(long timeoutMs)
        Awaits the group's startup connection up to timeoutMs, applying the configured NjamsSettings.PROPERTY_COMMUNICATION_STARTUP_FAILBEHAVIOR.
        Parameters:
        timeoutMs - maximum time to wait for the initial connect.
        Returns:
        true if the SDK may proceed; false to fail startup (fail-fast policy).

      • startWithTimeout

        public boolean startWithTimeout​(long timeoutMs,
                                boolean reconnectOnFailure)
        Awaits the group's startup connection up to timeoutMs, starting it if beginConnect() has not already done so.
        Parameters:
        timeoutMs - maximum time to wait for the initial connect.
        reconnectOnFailure - true for the reconnect startup policy: on failure the group enters the background reconnect loop and this returns true. false for fail-fast: on failure the connect is cancelled and this returns false.
        Returns:
        true if the SDK may proceed (connected, or reconnecting in the background); false to fail startup.

      • reconnectOnStartupFailure

        public static boolean reconnectOnStartupFailure​(ClientSettings settings)
        Resolves whether NjamsSettings.PROPERTY_COMMUNICATION_STARTUP_FAILBEHAVIOR is set to reconnect for the given settings, without exposing the internal StartupFailBehavior type. Used by Njams.start() to decide, for the sender only, which policy to pass to startWithTimeout(long, boolean). The receiver is not governed by this setting at all: its connection always retries unconditionally in the background, independently of the sender's startup fail-behavior.
        Parameters:
        settings - the settings to read the setting from.
        Returns:
        true if the startup fail-behavior is reconnect, false for the default fail and for exit.
        Since:
        6.1.0

      • exitOnStartupFailure

        public static boolean exitOnStartupFailure​(ClientSettings settings)
        Resolves whether NjamsSettings.PROPERTY_COMMUNICATION_STARTUP_FAILBEHAVIOR is set to exit for the given settings. Within the SDK exit behaves exactly like fail; this only lets Njams.startup() report the outcome as EXIT instead of FAIL.
        Parameters:
        settings - the settings to read the setting from.
        Returns:
        true if the startup fail-behavior is exit.
        Since:
        6.1.0

      • close

        public void close()
        This method closes the ThreadPoolExecutor safely. It awaits the termination for 10 seconds, after that, an InterruptedException will be thrown and the senders will be closed.

      • removeSenderExceptionListener

        public void removeSenderExceptionListener​(SenderExceptionListener listener)
        Removes a listener added with addSenderExceptionListener(SenderExceptionListener). A shared group outlives the clients using it, so a stopped client must take its listener with it.
        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to remove; unknown listeners and an uninitialized sender are ignored.
        Since:
        6.1.0

      • exceptionListenerCount

        public int exceptionListenerCount()
        Test-support accessor: the current number of SenderExceptionListeners registered on this sender's group. Not part of any public API contract (see communication-layer.md) — for integration-test introspection of listener-registration lifecycle only, e.g. across repeated start/stop of instances sharing a group via NjamsSettings.PROPERTY_SHARED_COMMUNICATIONS.
        Returns:
        the exception-listener registration count, or 0 if this sender was not initialized.

      • pooledSenderCount

        public int pooledSenderCount()
        Test-support accessor: the current total number of senders this sender's group's pool holds, checked out plus idle. Not part of any public API contract (see communication-layer.md) — for integration-test introspection of the pool's "virtually bounded to maxSenderThreads" invariant only (see SenderPool's class Javadoc).
        Returns:
        the pooled-sender count, or 0 if this sender was not initialized.
